source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 2 oz whisky, 6 oz seltzer; root recipe 2 oz whisky, 4 oz seltzer. The nominal spec (60 ml : 150 ml, 5 oz) lies between the two; the mixer band 2 - 6 parts contains both. The lower edge (2) follows the 1944 description of the Screwdriver and the IBA Screwdriver 1 : 2 as quoted on Wikipedia (secondary). The book files Aperol Spritz and Bloody Mary under this template; the optional slots are chosen here. See docs/templates.md#evidence.
